decisions.reason: The indoor air quality module serves lasting demand for climate monitoring and costs little to keep in a modular catalog, so the option stays open despite component supply uncertainty.
As the current hardware generation of a basic measurement building block, the voltage module carries established demand and has no reason to be withdrawn.
The MQTT proxy is cheap to keep available, but MQTT support built more directly into the platform may make it redundant, so the risk of retiring it is higher than for the hardware modules.
The CAN bus module fills a niche for automation and vehicle projects, and holding it costs little, so it is kept while its value keeps building.
Interest in CO2 measurement for ventilation has grown strongly, so the evidence now favors keeping and supporting this module.
The touch panel accessory has an uncertain but cheap-to-hold position as a complement to the platform, so it is kept rather than abandoned.
